messages:
Maria: Quick sync — can we finalize landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private before Thursday? Need final hero + CTAs for the webinar email.

AJ: Yup. Priorities: hero wording, CTAs + routing, benchmark callout, small homepage webinar promo.

Lee: Hero draft: "Run high-performance LLM inference where you need it — hosted for speed, dedicated for predictable throughput, private for compliance."

Sam: Tighten voice: "Run high-performance LLM inference — hosted for fast time-to-value, dedicated for predictable throughput, private for full control and compliance."

Maria: Good. Can we show one benchmark stat under the hero? e.g., "Benchmarked to 2.4× token throughput vs open endpoints" — we need method link if we publish.

Lee: We have internal WP numbers. 2.4× ok if we link to methodology. Add small "See methodology" link next to the stat.

AJ: Proposed CTAs and routing:
- Hosted: "Start free hosted trial" -> self-serve flow (marketing funnel)
- Dedicated: "Reserve dedicated capacity" -> enterprise queue + SSO sales path
- Private: "Request private deployment" -> AE + security review queue

Maria: For Dedicated/Private, can we tag Intercom leads with enterprise flags? SDRs should prioritize those.

Sam: Mapping pseudo:
```
if CTA == "Reserve dedicated capacity": tag = "enterprise-dedicated";
else if CTA == "Request private deployment": tag = "enterprise-private";
else: tag = "self-serve";
```
Also append utm_campaign=webinar-2026 to all outbound links.

DesignBot: Design note — tri-column hero OK if each column is 10–12 words max. Add a small benchmark chevron under the hero and a mode toggle.

Maria: Webinar promo line for top banner: "Join our webinar: How to cut inference cost and double throughput — live demo + Q&A". CTA: "Register — limited seats" and post-event "Watch on-demand".

Lee: Microcopy bullets under hero (3):
- "Low-latency production serving with predictable SLOs"
- "Autoscaling & reserved pools to meet SLA targets"
- "Private control plane with KMS & audit logs"

Sam: Keep the page friendly — avoid deep infra terms (no KV cache on main page). Add a small "See technical notes" link to docs for engineers.

AJ: Webflow tasks: push copy + data attributes for analytics. Buttons should have data-event "landing_cta_click" with property mode: hosted/dedicated/private and origin: hero/webinar-banner.

Design: QA note — make the three CTAs visually equal weight. Also need 3 hero images: hosted (developer), dedicated (platform), private (security). Marketing to supply 2 variants each.

Maria: I'll pull imagery and mock variations. Deadlines: assets by EOD Wed, copy freeze Thurs AM.

ProductOps: We need the Intercom routing rules confirmed. Will implement enterprise tags per mapping above.

Sam: Optional: run A/B test (stat vs no-stat) with feature flag, 50/50 split. Can measure webinar CTR + signups.

AJ: I'll create the feature flag and add analytics.

Maria: Action recap: AJ -> push Webflow + analytics (Wed PM). Design -> QA layout + spacing (Wed PM). Maria -> assets + benchmark link (Wed EOD). Lee/Sam -> confirm stat + methodology link (Tue). ProductOps -> Intercom rules (Wed).

AJ: Got it. Ping when live so I can update webinar email copy. :thumbsup:
